inputs: Seeded normal FP32 BSHD-to-BHSD tensors; not captured model activations.
timing: Complete callable, including checks, allocations and required dtype conversions. Wall time includes final synchronization; events include host submission gaps. Input creation and backend warmup are excluded. Pair order alternates; no graphs.
probe_timing: FP32 QKV -> target-dtype casts -> single forced SDPA backend -> FP32 output. The single-backend context is included in the callable cost.

acceptance_declared_before_measurement.exact_fp32_path: Finite outputs and identical contiguous uint8 views.
acceptance_declared_before_measurement.note: Random operator error is diagnostic; it cannot accept a real-image precision change.
